title: 32 DE guides compare big-bike model ranges (BMW, Triumph, Harley, Kawasaki…) with weak relation to Hanoi rental/mobility intent and no measured demand

expected_result: DE topical map stays inside the travel-mobility scope.
verification: Matrix review of DE vehicle-choice silo.

title: Most Matrix primary queries are long-tail hypotheses with no measurable search volume (serp_evidence NOT_VALIDATED)
action: Before promoting new IDEA rows, score candidates with real keyword data per market; keep long-tail question topics for AEO but order the Writer queue by demand and topical gap.
expected_result: Writer queue ordered by validated demand + topical need.
verification: keyword-metrics.json re-run per market each month.
done_criteria: Topic Factory stores keyword metrics per candidate; ≥1 validated head/body query per Hub.

title: Every article's author is the Organization; no human review (facts_reviewed_by_human=false) — correctly disclosed by the AI-provenance note
action: Keep the honest provenance note. If the owner adds real human fact review, record reviewer identity and date per article; never invent bylines. Strengthen the About page with editorial method and correction policy.
expected_result: Trust signals improve without fabricated reviews.

title: Coverage is uneven: DE has ~2.7× the published guides of other locales; ES has the fewest
action: Steer Writer claims toward ES/VI/NL/ZH/PT/KO/JA READY rows; DE refill is RESEARCH_NEEDED anyway.
expected_result: Each locale within ±25% of the median guide count.

title: fact-guard flags sourced third-party prices that need a dated re-check

verification: fact-guard WARN count for the article = 0.
